SELECT SQ_COMPANY.NEXTVAL FROM dual
INSERT INTO company (company_id, company_code, company_name, trial_email, requested_seats, trial_requested_at) VALUES (#{companyId}, #{companyCode}, #{companyName}, #{trialEmail}, #{requestedSeats}, #{trialRequestedAt})

INSERT INTO service_period (service_period_id, company_id, period_type, starts_at, ends_at, purchased_seats, billing_anchor_date) VALUES (#{servicePeriodId}, #{companyId}, 'PD_TRIAL', #{startsAt}, #{endsAt}, #{purchasedSeats}, #{billingAnchorDate})

SELECT SQ_SERVICE_PERIOD.NEXTVAL FROM dual
INSERT INTO service_period (service_period_id, company_id, period_type, subscription_plan_id, starts_at, ends_at, purchased_seats, billing_anchor_date, source_order_id) VALUES (#{servicePeriodId}, #{companyId}, 'PD_PAID', #{subscriptionPlanId}, #{startsAt}, #{endsAt}, #{purchasedSeats}, #{billingAnchorDate}, #{sourceOrderId})
mapper.select: SELECT company_id FROM company WHERE company_id = #{companyId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT sp.service_period_id, sp.company_id, CASE WHEN sp.period_type = 'PD_TRIAL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS trial, sp.starts_at, sp.ends_at, sp.purchased_seats, sp.billing_anchor_date, CASE pl.plan_code WHEN 'PLAN_YEARLY' THEN 'ANNUAL' WHEN 'PLAN_MONTHLY' THEN 'MONTHLY' END AS plan FROM service_period sp LEFT JOIN subscription_plan pl ON pl.subscription_plan_id = sp.subscription_plan_id WHERE sp.company_id = #{companyId} ORDER BY sp.starts_at, sp.service_period_id

SELECT sp.service_period_id, sp.company_id, CASE WHEN sp.period_type = 'PD_TRIAL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS trial, sp.starts_at, sp.ends_at, sp.purchased_seats, sp.billing_anchor_date, CASE pl.plan_code WHEN 'PLAN_YEARLY' THEN 'ANNUAL' WHEN 'PLAN_MONTHLY' THEN 'MONTHLY' END AS plan FROM service_period sp LEFT JOIN subscription_plan pl ON pl.subscription_plan_id = sp.subscription_plan_id ORDER BY sp.company_id, sp.starts_at, sp.service_period_id
